body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 5cdb0b9dd80ec5a667babc4597f0fc30b69aa58d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review of the fix for the earlier needs-rework).

**What looks good**
- Merge commit `5cdb0b9d`, read with `git show --remerge-diff`: one hand hunk, `generate.rs` (~2830-2930). It takes main's `let ctx = VerifyContext {..}` / `verify_bodies(&path,&ctx,..)` / `stock_top_law::acquit` form and adds only `rims: &rims` beside `model_excess`. Nothing else was resolved by hand; the other hunks are the fix itself.
- Dropping Thread from `rims_of` (`material_source.rs:340-350`) can only judge a thread op more strictly, never looser. With empty rims `is_rim` is false, so `loop_tol` and `floor_of` (`sim/verify/section.rs`) give the tightened tolerance, which is main's pre-PR reading for Thread. The PR changes nothing for thread ops against main.
- Drill (no cross holes) and Bore still declare their rims and only those loops read the plain tolerance. Non-rim loops stay tightened.

**Local results** (merged with upstream main 84c96835, own target, sccache)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-sim --lib | 113 passed |
| app coarse_rims | 5 passed |
| hole_wall_flats / hole_wall_pins | 4 / 5 passed |
| thread_mill_rim | 11 passed |
| solid_law / solid_law_goldens | 4 / 6 passed |
| drill_prior / golden_cl / coarse_contain | 12 / 26 / 1 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Mutation checks**
- Drill and Bore arms emptied: `a_matched_drill_is_clean_on_a_model_flagged_anywhere_below_the_refusal_bound` and `a_matched_bore_is_clean_near_the_refusal_bound` go red (the drill/bore part is still pinned).
- Thread arm re-added to `rims_of`: **stays green**. Loosening law (b) to the plain tolerance everywhere: **stays green**.
- So the new thread pin `a_thread_mill_on_a_coarse_model_is_never_read_looser_than_at_full_fidelity` does not go red when Thread is made looser. The fixture is clean at full fidelity, so the pin's `w == full || gouged(&w)` can't register a looser reading, and a minor-radius declaration traces no loop under #1071's major rims. The safety claim holds from the code above, not from this pin; the pin only guards against a thread verdict that is neither equal nor a gouge. Not blocking, since behaviour equals main's.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. If you want the thread pin to bite, use a thread fixture that gouges or warns at full fidelity (so "never looser" has something to lose) and assert the coarse verdict contains every full-fidelity warning. Or retitle it as a no-regression pin.
2. `generate.rs` and `material_source.rs` are over 400 lines already (not blocking).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
